notes.title: Update 1.19
notes.content:
- Fixed a runic circle bug in a situation where a player died while casting a spell.
- Fixed an error with the incorrect clock position when the game was first launched on some devices.
- Fixed a visual error when the destroyed alchemical cauldron continued to emit particles.
- Removed the ability to apply the item [piece of armor] to yourself.
- Improved the informativeness of the save/load window. Now the stage of the saved game, its difficulty and the kill count are displayed there.
- Graphical setting of vertical synchronization has been added to the game options. It is recommended to play with the option disabled, but enabling it may help in some cases with non-standard equipment.
Previously, this option was enabled by default and could cause the gameplay speed to slow down.
- Removed the "Potato" mode for weak computers. Now the game automatically limits the operation of some shaders and the number of particles in case of a shortage of computer resources.
- Fixed the localization errors of the Sulphurata spell.
- Fixed a bug where long-range unique NPCs could use a stunning melee attack from a long distance.
- Ranged units are now unable to shoot through some obstacles.

notes.title: Update 1.18
notes.content:
- Skeleton mastery skill was overwhelmed with difficulty compared to other spells. Now the attributes and weapons of skeletons will depend not on the quality of the reagent, but on the skill level.
- The [Old book], which the player picks up at the beginning of the game, now teaches not only the spell "Rat master", but also the "Demonic Gate". The old terms of use of the gate often confused new players.
- Fixed a bug where miners and fishermen overflowed their inventory with resources without handing them over to the warehouse.
- Another one object has appeared in the swamps, allowing you to get an additional skill point. But are you ready to pay with your own blood for new knowledge?

notes.title: Update 1.17
notes.content:
- Now, when activating some mechanics (desecrating altars, collecting tricea, summoning minions, etc.), the player will see the progress or limit of this activity.
- In the form of a raven, the landing marker is now visible.
- Miners now mine ore faster, but will carry less. This change will not affect the settlement's economy, but will make it easier for the player to hunt for ore.
- Some members of the Order can now buy additional equipment.
- Bandits and Moroks now come to the location not along the Royal Route, but through a secret passage in the mountains. This change better shows the character of the units, and also minimizes the unwanted increase in the kill counter by bandits.
- A skill point is now awarded for killing Patriarch Chaplain Cain.
- At the request of the players, the character's story is no longer forced to end after completing the main plot. The player is free to stay at the location and continue performing any activities: collecting resources, hunting people and animals, completing the ongoing achievements and research. The kill 
counter will still trigger various events, resetting to zero each time it is triggered. Thus, the game will go into endless mode, allowing the player to try out all the skills and mechanics within one game.
- Added a new type of fighters - recruits. They will be the main fighting force of the Order in endless mode.

[b]Thanks to the community for contributing to the development of the game! [/b]

notes.title: Update 1.16
notes.content:
- Fixed situations where it was possible to specify allied minions as targets for an attack. The target designation function is also disabled at the stage of the quest prologue.
- Each summoning of a bronze imp now spends 5 health points of the warlock.
- The maximum attack range with an enchanted dagger is now fixed and does not depend on the skill level.
- The final scene of the game is graphically optimized.
- At the request of the players, the "potatoe" mode has been added to the game options. The mode greatly reduces the quality of graphics and drawing range, allowing in some cases to play even on computers below the minimum system requirements. The mode is not saved and requires manual activation every time you start the game.
- Special properties can now be assigned to Lihedera at any time, and not only during creation. To do this, you need to put the missing reagents next to the predatory plant and cast a summoning spell.
- The use of dark magic now leaves its mark on the character. Sleep and food will regenerate less health after a certain kill counter. In this case, the player will receive a corresponding message, and the character's eyes will glow like those of an undead.
- The Phylacteria spell has been reworked and strengthened.
[i]* the amount of health restored is increased.
* upon resurrection, the necromancer gains 25 armor for a few seconds.
* changed animation of absorbed souls.
* at the maximum level of the skill, the necromancer will expel negative energy in case of death, causing damage to everyone around.[/i]

[b]Thanks to the community for contributing to the development of the game! [/b]

notes.title: Update 1.15
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug leading to the breakage of the saved game if the recording was made at the time of decapitation of the NPC.
- Fixed a bug that allowed to take items from the inventory while the rune wheel is active, which could lead to inaccuracies in casting spells.
- The decay time of corpses has been increased by one and a half minutes. Bodies now lie on the ground longer.
- Fixed a save / load bug where villagers could re-participate in a raid event.
- Pillagers now break furniture with great zeal, shouting threats and using special animations. The time required for complete destruction of interior items during a raid has also been increased.
- Optimized the code for summoning some minions.
- Added descriptions for most Steam Achievements.
- Tricea can no longer be put into the alchemy cauldron.
- Added the ability to select the difficulty of the game.
Difficulty changes affect the following aspects:
[i]* maximum number of lives of the necromancer.
* number of enemies triggered by kill counter events.
* the amount of health that opponents restore through healing potions.
* the number of night watchmen patrolling the area if the settlement has enough resources.
* behavior of the rune wheel. On low difficulty, the starting angle of rotation is always the same.[/i]
The difficulty of the game does not affect the attributes of hostile, neutral or friendly units.
Medium difficulty is identical to the settings of previous versions of the game, so old saves will automatically work on medium difficulty.
The choice of difficulty is set once at the start of a new game and cannot be changed.
You can find out the current difficulty level in the statistics window in the map mode.

[b]Thanks to the community for contributing to the development of the game![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.content:
[b]! Old saves may not work correctly. It is recommended to start a new game![/b]

- Objects related to gaining experience received azure illumination.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to escape from the fight in the final moment of the prologue.
- Fixed some inaccuracies in English and German localization.
- White aspen is now only visible during the prologue.
- At the request of players, the physical colliders of some units have been slightly increased to make it easier to click on them. The changes affected muads, chickens, foxes and hares.
- The dagger now changes color based on active effects.
- Summoned rats (muads) received a summoning animation.
- Fixed incorrect character behavior when trying to climb the platform in the destroyed lighthouse.
- Improved interface and animations related to the alchemy cauldron.
- Locked chests have been added to various places on the map, containing useful items - resources, potions and food of high rarity. Some NPCs have a small chance of spawning with an iron key on their belt. When killing such a character, you can pick up the key and open any of the chests. Extra keys can be melted in the cauldron according to the recipe: [iron key + heat + heat].
- It also became possible to melt pieces of armor if you are in dire need of iron or do not use minions. Recipe: [piece of armor + piece of armor + heat + heat].

[b]Many thanks to the community for contributing to the development of the game![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.13
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug when saving/loading allowed to summon bronze imps above the set limit.
- Fixed a camera bug caused by the death of a character in Malum mode.
- Fixed a bug with an "invisible wall" in the northern part of the map, permanently blocking the movement of the character.
- Fixed a bug with an irreversible action 'pick up an item'.
- The summoned rats (Muads) have become larger in size and have acquired a bluish tint. Now it will be easier for the player to distinguish them from normal rats.
- For all units, the enemy detection code has been rewritten to a more optimized one. Fixed rare situations where enemy units could not see each other even at the minimum distance.
- The hunters of the settlement have learned to simulate hunting prey with the appropriate animation.
- Reduced the display range of most effects (fear, poisoning, stun, falling leaves, smoke, arrows, etc.).
- Previously, the poisoning of cauldrons with food was a means of finishing off seriously wounded units, receiving a dose of poison instead of healing. At the same time, the player had a kill counter and it was difficult to understand who exactly died and where to pick up the dropped loot.
 With the release of Update 1.13, characters will not only eat for healing, but also when they are hungry. Eating from poisoned cauldrons will permanently reduce maximum health and movement speed when seriously sick. 
In addition, it became possible to infect the cauldrons with Worstlings - parasites from the demonology skill tree and the White Plague from the necromancy.
Now gradually and systematically poisoning cauldrons throughout the map will give you a tactical advantage, making your opponents sluggish and vulnerable, without increasing the kill counter until you decide to do it yourself.

[b]Many thanks to the community for contributing to the development of the game![/b]

- Fixed a bug with an irreversible action 'pick up an item'.
- For all units, the enemy detection code has been rewritten to a more optimized one. Fixed rare situations where enemy units could not see each other even at the minimum distance.

- Added storage for bones, feathers and rat tails.
- Attempting to pick up an item with a full overload is now accompanied by a sound signal and a backlight of the inventory button.
- The achievement for looting a cemetery is now awarded for 50 ravaged graves, instead of 100.
- With the release of Update 1.12, the player will no longer receive skill points for 20,40,60 and 80 kills. Instead, added the system of research, as well as the corresponding element of the interior. Research will require a certain amount of resources, but will allow you to obtain skills points early in the game when they are needed most.
- 'Use' button (default 'E') now marks neutral creatures as hostile to your minions.
- Fixed a bug where the kill counter sometimes counted two kills as one.

notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.content:
- At players’ request, controls have been changed. Use left click for moving, attacking and collecting items; hold right or middle mouse button to control the camera.
- The character will now automatically walk towards the items you click to collect. Before, the player had to do that manually.
- Destroyed zombies now have a 40% chance to leave behind their crawling top halves. Crawlers behave like any other undead units do and are controlled in the same way.
- At an attempt to summon the undead during daytime, the clock will now flash red to indicate the mistake. It will also flash at the change of the time of day.
- You can now hover over items to see their quality.
- Added: 2560x1440 resolution option.
- Added: French localization.
- The bug allowing the player to use the cart inventory in the Malum mode has been fixed.
- Village hens no longer try to attack demons and the undead.

notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.content:
- Trees can no longer be cut by lumberjacks or the Lihedera spell. This change will not affect the mechanics of the game, but it will have a positive effect on performance, save files and visual aspects of the game.
- The area around the lumberjack camp has been slightly changed.
- Moroks are now better at hiding after the battle.
- The Brawlers led by Hector the Prospector, as planned, did not leave the ruins of the lighthouse, even when all the interior items were destroyed. Now Brawlers will no longer stay at the lighthouse if Hector is killed.
- Added dialogue animation to make characters look more alive. Now they shout cries in battle and communicate with each other while resting. Instead of a dozen hackneyed phrases and to avoid the additional burden on localization, it was decided to endow them with their own untranslatable alphabet. According to the context of what is happening, the player will understand whether the settlers are chatting about the weather or threatening him with violence.

notes.content:
- It is now impossible to accidentally click on objects in the background through the window of the spellbook, map and alchemy.
- Unintentional double-clicking on action icons in alchemy mode now does not break the process of creating a potion.
- Fixed some translation inaccuracies.
- The starting quest chain has been shortened, moving the player closer to the village after completing some errands.
- Added a new item [piece of armor] with which you can improve the protection of minions - skeletons, zombies, demons and sulphurata. Parts of the armor can be looted from fighters or found in the world when starting a new game. For the convenience of keeping track of the armor upgrade status, fortified minions now wear helmets. Due to this, skeletons called in previous versions may have some visual inconsistencies that do not affect the performance or balance of the game.
